name: Enterprise B2B Kanban Board Deals & Interactive Controls
description: Verify HubSpot-grade Kanban board with financial KPI ribbon, + New Deal creation, stages, and interactive filters

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login, sign in as admin@flowcrm.local with password 'FlowAdmin123!', and navigate to /pipeline
Verify the Financial Aggregate Ribbon renders Total Pipeline value, Weighted Forecast, Open Deals count, and Win Rate percentage
Verify 5 Kanban stage columns are present: Discovery & Qualified, Technical Evaluation, Proposal & Quote, Contract Negotiation, and Closed Won
Click '+ New Deal' button in the top header
Fill Deal Title '100 Tubs Whey Isolate Wholesale Order', Amount '85000', select Stage 'Proposal & Quote', and click 'Create Deal'
Assert modal closes and new deal card appears in the 'Proposal & Quote' column
Verify board displays matching deal cards according to active filter
